description: React functional component for a playback control bar in a media application, handling playback controls, shuffle, repeat, volume, and displaying current track info.

methods.name: handlePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles playback between play and pause states, dispatching corresponding actions.

methods.name: handleSkip
methods.description: Dispatches skip command to move forward or backward in the queue based on the direction parameter.

methods.name: handleVolume
methods.description: Updates the volume state based on slider input.
